items.item_text: A Bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, public relations, marketing, or related field
7 or more years of professional writing experience
Experience in academic, health care, research, and/or science settings
Experience collaborating with stakeholders at all levels and adapting your approach to their needs
Experience with content management systems and email platforms
Experience developing content independently and meeting multiple deadlines as priorities shift in a fast-paced environment
Advanced knowledge of communication platforms and experience developing strategies that connect with audiences across channels

As Senior Writer, you will find, research, write, and edit original stories about the scientific advances, people, programs, and initiatives shaping UCLA Health. You will create health and science content for internal and external audiences and report to the Managing Editor of the Content Team within Marketing.

As a senior member of the health and science writing team within Omnichannel, you will adapt your approach across service lines, editorial priorities, and formats, from blog posts and web articles to long-form magazine features. You will exercise independent editorial judgment when covering complex or sensitive topics and addressing challenges with limited precedent.
Identify and develop original story ideas that reflect UCLA Health’s strategic priorities and the interests of its audiences.
Translate complex health and science topics into clear, engaging content for consumers, healthcare peers, and internal audiences.
Write compelling headlines that connect with readers and support search engine optimization (SEO).
Collaborate with the Creative and Strategy teams to develop content that reaches broad audiences, strengthens UCLA Health’s reputation, and supports brand growth.
Partner with Media Relations and Internal Communications to align stories with shared priorities and reach the audiences they serve.
Manage content programs as needed, shaping their strategy and overseeing the policies and processes that support them.
Expertise in health reporting, including accessible content for general readers, coverage of medical innovations and healthcare communities, and in-depth profiles
Strong news judgement and editorial instincts
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to write effectively for a variety of purposes, audiences, platforms, and media
Advanced writing and storytelling skills, with a track record of producing clear, engaging copy access formats
